objects.taxonomy_description: Ring-shaped bread roll with a glossy, chewy crust and dense interior crumb. The toroidal form features a central hole approximately 2-3 cm in diameter with an overall diameter of 10-12 cm. May be topped with sesame seeds, poppy seeds, or coarse salt.

objects.taxonomy_description: Cylindrical stick of wax (15-30 cm tall, 2-5 cm diameter) with a central wick (cotton string) extending from the top. The wax body is smooth and uniform, available in white, ivory, or colored varieties. The surface has a matte or slightly glossy finish depending on wax type (paraffin, beeswax, soy). The top has a charred wick tip if previously burned. Taper candles narrow toward the top; pillar candles maintain uniform diameter. The base is flat for standing. Scented candles may have a slightly textured surface from fragrance oils. The overall shape is a simple vertical cylinder with a thin wick protruding from the center.

Simple vertical cylinder with thin wick protruding from center.
Taper candles narrow toward top while pillar candles maintain uniform diameter.

Charred wick tip if previously burned.

objects.taxonomy_description: Domestic swine measuring 90-180 cm body length weighing 50-350 kg. Body stocky and barrel-shaped with sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin. Head large with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting. Eyes small. Ears large and floppy or erect depending on breed. Legs short and stout with cloven hooves. Tail short and curly. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Omnivorous with highly developed olfactory sense.

Sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short stout legs with cloven hooves.
